data.theme: Self-Efficacy and Motivational Competencies in Engineering
data.definition: The development and validation of instruments to measure engineering students' self-efficacy and motivational attitudes, including general engineering self-efficacy, programming self-efficacy, and design self-efficacy. These studies assess how motivational factors influence learning, performance, and engagement in engineering contexts.

data.theme: Motivational and Behavioral Competencies in Engineering Education
data.definition: The assessment of engineering students' motivational attitudes, self-regulated learning, and engagement behaviors, particularly in capstone design courses. These studies focus on developing instruments to measure intrinsic motivation, sustainable engineering attitudes, and teamwork-related behaviors.

data.theme: Systems Thinking and Complex Problem-Solving Competencies
data.definition: The assessment of engineering students' ability to understand, analyze, and solve complex, interdisciplinary problems using systems thinking approaches. These studies focus on developing instruments to measure active learning, problem-based learning outcomes, and data-driven assessment of systems thinking skills.

The validation of instruments to evaluate engineering students' perceptions of workplace support, generic competencies, and learning outcomes from internships and community-partnered projects. These studies focus on measuring the impact of work experience on employability and professional development.
